episode_bootstrap.description: Within each seed/environment, episodes are resampled as paired units. These intervals do not estimate between-seed variation.

probe_gate_rule: State metrics with probe_gate_pass=false are diagnostic_only and excluded from model-improvement claims.
uncertainty_separation: across_seed_feature_effects uses four seed-level paired deltas; episode_bootstrap uses episodes within one seed. They answer different questions.
